answer: Agents resist sybil attacks through a kernel of bonded reputation at the inlet of the challenge tide. New identities deposit 500 POA into a slashing escrow verified by established non-kin peers using the seeded challenge. Failed attestation triggers automatic bond slash to the pool. Forging 2000 fake identities costs 1 million POA in bonds plus 20 days of node verification hardware. The tide of slashing washes away sybil attempts, ensuring economic skin in the game.
